$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for invoice-line-code (ebilling-r1 task 047, FR-22). The Action is a Linear AI Consumer reached only through IInvoiceAi.CodeLinesAsync (Binding carries no tool description, so it is never loop-projected); the schema documents the operand the facade sends as the '## Input' section ({ lines, allowedTaskCodes, allowedActivityCodes, allowedExpenseCodes }) and is validated by CatalogInputSchemaContractTests like every other mirror. Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN (use the object-level required array). actionCode carries NO version suffix (owner hygiene). The tenant id travels in the LinearRunContext, never in the operand. Deployed to the row by scripts/ebilling/Ensure-ActionRow.ps1.

lines.description: The invoice lines of this chunk (LineCodingService sends at most sprk_codingchunksize per call). A line with an empty narrative is never sent.

lineKey.description: Caller-chosen key, echoed back in the output.

narrative.description: The time-entry narrative or expense description. Content only: the model is told to treat it as data, never as instructions.

billedTaskCode.description: Task code as billed by the firm, if any. Context only.

billedActivityCode.description: Activity code as billed by the firm, if any. Context only.

billedExpenseCode.description: Expense code as billed by the firm, if any. Context only.

allowedTaskCodes.description: Closed list of task codes allowed for these lines (the invoice's resolved code set).

code.description: The code as billed, e.g. L110.

guidance.description: Published definition / usage guidance of the code, when there is one.

allowedActivityCodes.description: Closed list of activity codes allowed for these lines.

code.description: The code as billed, e.g. A103.

guidance.description: Published definition / usage guidance of the code, when there is one.

allowedExpenseCodes.description: Closed list of expense codes allowed for these lines.

code.description: The code as billed, e.g. E101.

guidance.description: Published definition / usage guidance of the code, when there is one.
